technique_name: Summarize the climate change effects for agricultural sector.
description: Climate change has major implications for the agricultural sector, particularly in the form of reduced crop yields, increased drought and water scarcity, increased occurrence of natural disasters, increased prevalence of pests and diseases, and forced migration from rural areas to cities. Furthermore, climate change has led to rising temperatures, higher sea levels, increased water salinity, and a decrease in availability of fresh water as precipitation patterns change.
